lines.2: Even during the drama club's training camp, Konoe called me every night.
lines.3: 「...Haha, Yamada's pretty slick too. (Still on the phone.)」
lines.4: 「Hey, how long are you gonna stay on that phone!?」
lines.6: I shooed Crab away with a wave.
lines.7: 「Hey! Don't just brush me off! I'm bored!」
lines.9: 「Grr... Damn it, Subaru. You've gotten good.」
lines.11: 「I've been telling you I'll teach you.」
lines.13: 「Haha, you got crushed. Brainy games like this just aren't for you, Crab.」
lines.14: 「You've got a lot of nerve, Sewer Four-Eyes.」
lines.18: 「This guy looks pretty strong. So it can breathe fire and torch the square right in front of it, right?」
lines.19: 「No, it can't do anything like that.」
lines.20: 「What the hell? What a useless horse. Isn't there some long-range sniper who can take out the enemy king in one shot?」
lines.21: 「Then whoever goes first would have a huge advantage!」
lines.24: 「Good! I'll learn the rest as I go!」
lines.28: 「Hm? Oh, it's nothing. My childhood friends are over.」
lines.30: 「Huh? What's with the outburst, Crab Fried Rice?」
lines.31: 「What a buzzkill, Leo! You barely talk to us--you're always on the phone with Konoe!」
lines.32: 「That's how a guy is when he's just gotten a girlfriend.」
lines.33: 「Expect Leo to stay glued to his phone for a while.」
lines.34: 「Hah! There isn't a single decent girl with twintails!」
lines.35: 「You wore twintails yourself in your tender youth, didn't you?」
lines.36: 「Fukahire, you're awfully relaxed at a time like this.」
lines.37: 「Yeah. I made Leo promise me something.」
lines.38: 「I told him to have Konoe introduce me to a girl.」
lines.40: 「You think you get to be the only one who's happy? Dream on.」
lines.41: 「So, found me a nice girl yet?」
lines.42: 「Apparently every girl says no once she sees your picture.」
lines.44: 「Hmm. Fukahire's worked this hard. You'd think it ought to pay off for him by now.」
